# PREVENCY

> > PREVENCY® delivers immersive crisis simulation and InfoRange® training software to build organizational readiness through realistic scenario-based learning.

PREVENCY is a German crisis management training provider specializing in simulation software for enterprises, government agencies, military, and educational institutions. The platform helps organizations prepare for complex crises including cybersecurity threats, reputation warfare, supply chain disruptions, and cognitive warfare scenarios.

## Key Topics

- Crisis Simulation
- Crisis Management
- InfoRange® Training
- Business Continuity
- Crisis Communication
- Risk Management
- Emergency Preparedness
- Scenario-Based Learning
- NATO Certification
- Reputation Management
- Supply Chain Resilience
- Cybersecurity
- Employee Training
- Digital Literacy
- Cognitive Warfare

## Core Products & Services

- [PREVENCY® - Readiness through experience](https://prevency.com/en): English language homepage for PREVENCY crisis simulation platform
- [Krisensimulation: Crisis Management Training](https://prevency.com/krisensimulation): Immersive crisis simulation for team training and risk management
- [InfoRange® - Military & Security Training](https://prevency.com/militaer-und-sicherheitsbehoerden): Leading training software for information space with NATO certification for cognitive warfare
- [Subscription: Independent InfoRange® Training](https://prevency.com/subscription): Subscription licensing for independent crisis simulation training

## Industry Solutions

- [Enterprise & Institutional Solutions](https://prevency.com/unternehmen-und-institutionen): Crisis simulation solutions for enterprises and institutions
- [Agencies & Consulting Firms](https://prevency.com/agenturen-und-beratungen): Crisis simulation software for agencies and consulting firms
- [Schools & Educational Institutions](https://prevency.com/schulen-und-bildungseinrichtungen): Media simulation for schools addressing fake news and digital literacy
